description: This file implements the functionality for hashing objects within the Git version control system, including handling files, standard input, and integrating with the repository's object database. It provides the 'git hash-object' command logic, including options for object type, writing to the database, and reading from stdin or stdin paths.

methods.name: void hash_fd(int fd,const char * type,const char * path,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Hashes a file descriptor's content, outputs the object ID in hex, and handles database insertion if required.

methods.name: void hash_object(const char * path,const char * type,const char * vpath,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Hashes the file at the given path with specified type and virtual path.

methods.name: void hash_stdin_paths(const char * type,int no_filters,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Reads file paths from standard input and hashes each file accordingly.

methods.name: int cmd_hash_object(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
